items.prompt: A 2 by 2 input has rows [001,X] and [Y,02]. Which returned value preserves both the clockwise map and token spelling?

options.why: The coordinates match but parsing tokens as integers destroys the required leading zeros.
Token spelling is preserved but these are transposed rows, not clockwise rows.
The supplied function returns one joined string per output row, not one string per cell.
The first row reads the old left column bottom-to-top, and all token text remains unchanged.

items.explanation: The first row reads the old left column bottom-to-top, and all token text remains unchanged.
